scope: PHI-OTDR only; bidirectional January versus April-May acquisition-era transfer

closed_set_controls.selection_rule: evaluate all already-fitted development controls; no post-query selection

open_world.outer_protocol: leave one of six event classes unknown
open_world.window_preprocessing: source_train seen classes only: StandardScaler then PCA(24)
open_world.detection_score: negative mean distance to the three nearest source_train sessions of each seen class
open_world.enrollment_descriptor: 19 quantiles over 24 deterministic random projections (sliced-Wasserstein approximation)
open_world.enrollment_classifier: negative mean distance to three nearest enrolled/source session descriptors

aligned_encoder.precision: CUDA float16 autocast; float32 alignment loss

statistics.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over held-out-class means
statistics.multiplicity: report exact p-values and treat six held-out classes as the inferential clusters

stop_go_decisions_frozen.motif_tokenization: not confirmatory: no physical motif labels and continuous distributional modeling already produced a positive development signal

validity_statements: No target_query observation may fit preprocessing, choose a model, set a threshold, select support, or change this protocol.
The target_calibration partition contains known-class labels for threshold calibration only; each held-out class is excluded in its fold.
The target_support partition is used only after detection for unknown-class enrollment.
All windows from a session remain in one partition.
Acquisition era is observed, but site, fiber, subject, and environment identifiers are unavailable; conclusions must not claim invariance to those factors.
The target query is prospectively protected only relative to v2 development; repository-wide historical analyses exposed all files and are disclosed.
